# bluestonepim_matrix_attribute_definition (Resource)

Attribute definition of the `matrix` data type: a grid of named rows and columns, each cell holding a value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bluestonepim_matrix_attribute_definition" "size_chart" {
  name   = "Size chart"
  number = "size-chart"

  columns = [
    { value = "S" },
    { value = "M" },
    { value = "L" },
  ]

  rows = [
    { value = "Chest" },
    { value = "Waist" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `columns` (Attributes List) The columns of the matrix. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))
- `name` (String) The name of the attribute definition.
- `rows` (Attributes List) The rows of the matrix. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rows))

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the attribute definition.
- `external_source` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is an external source.
- `group_id` (String) The ID of the attribute group (see `bluestonepim_attribute_group`).
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is internal.
- `number` (String) The number of the attribute definition.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Platform-generated unique identifier of the attribute definition.
